data.name: Audit learning content before macOS build
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR"
node "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/export-audit-data.cjs"
python3 "$CM_BUILD_DIR/automation/learning-sprint-question-pipeline/validate_questions.py" \
  "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/learning-sprint-audit.json"
bash -n "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/prepare-web-assets.sh"
python3 - <<'PY'
import plistlib
with open('ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy','rb') as f:
    data=plistlib.load(f)
assert data.get('NSPrivacyTracking') is False
assert data.get('NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes') == []
print('PASS: Privacy Manifest parses and matches no-data-collection implementation.')
PY

data.name: Install project tools
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 brew install xcodegen imagemagick

data.name: Generate Xcode project
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2"
xcodegen generate
PLIST="$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Info.plist"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleIconName AppIcon" "$PLIST" 2>/dev/null || /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconName string AppIcon" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Delete :CFBundleIconFiles" "$PLIST" 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles array" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles:0 string AppIcon-120.png" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles:1 string AppIcon-152" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles:2 string AppIcon-167" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles:3 string AppIcon-180" "$PLIST"

data.name: Verify bundled release inputs
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Web/index.html"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Web/audit-fixes.js"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Web/question-order-v1.js"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :CFBundleIconName" "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Info.plist"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/AppIcon-120.png"
test -f "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/AppIcon-152.png"

data.name: Apply App Store signing profiles
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2"
xcode-project use-profiles
PLIST="$CM_BUILD_DIR/ios/health-manager-2/HealthManager2/Info.plist"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleIconName AppIcon" "$PLIST" 2>/dev/null || /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconName string AppIcon" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Delete :CFBundleIconFiles" "$PLIST" 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles array" "$PLIST"
/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :CFBundleIconFiles:0 string AppIcon-120" "$PLIST"
